# Copilot Instructions

## Tool & Skill Usage Policy

- Before invoking any tool or skill for the **first time in a session**, ask the user for explicit permission.
- Ask once per tool/skill per session — do not re-ask if already approved.
- Present a concise one-line description of what the tool/skill does and why it is needed.
- If the user declines, proceed without that tool/skill or propose an alternative approach.
- Example prompt: _"Need to approve use of `run_in_terminal` to check Docker service status. Yes[Y], No[N]"_
